title: global MP4 sidx materially changes remote access

definition.title: global MP4 sidx materially changes remote access
definition.source_excerpt: The two 60-second fMP4 files use the same codec/source construction; one contains a global sidx, the other uses skip_sidx. Without sidx, Chromium sequentially requested essentially the entire 3,362,971-byte resource before metadata became ready. With sidx, the total through the same metadata+seek operation was 1,069,611 bytes, a 68.2% reduction. This is a synthetic local Range server and one Chrome build; response cap, latency and server behavior can change the exact savings. But the qualitative result is strong: the index allows materially more selective access.
